tagline: Read Word, Excel and PowerPoint in the app.
subtitle: A read-only viewer for Office files and CSV, and a website that restyles itself.

cards.title: Office files open in a viewer
cards.text: Word, Excel, PowerPoint and CSV files open read-only in the Code tab and the file view, with find, zoom and a dark look.

cards.title: Select, then add to your message
cards.text: Select a passage in the viewer and add it to your message for the agent.

cards.title: A website that builds and restyles itself
cards.text: The page-building crew invites a click, restyles the whole page in three looks with Keep and Undo, and the site opens fast on slow networks.

also: README and site lead with the workflows
